'''Sayuri Ichiishi''' (Japanese: '''{{j|一石小百合}}''') is the former lead character designer for {{aniseries|PTS}} and currently works for [[OLM, Inc.]] 

In addition to this, she worked as an animation director in the [[EP001|first episode]] and ''[[Mewtwo Returns]]'', and as an illustrator for the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]]. The single card that she illustrated, {{TCG ID|P Promo|Pichu Bros.|28}}, was a promotion for ''[[PK11|Camp Pikachu]]'', a [[Pikachu short]] for which she had worked as the character designer. 

Up to ''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]'', she occasionally worked on a few episodes as key animator and for this series up through the beginning of ''[[Pokémon Horizons: The Series]]'', she did work regularly as a key animator for multiple episodes. Additionally, she does help with the creation of each [[Pokémon movie]], was involved in the animation of ''[[XY067|The Moment of Lumiose Truth!]]'', and has been credited as an animation director for [[XY096|one episode]] of ''[[Pokémon the Series: XY]]'', several episodes of ''[[Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon]]'' and one episode of ''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]''.
